notes.title: UPDATE 2 – Three Player Mode added and more!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32005976/47fbf30adb55fe150f189181d02a020577e0d3d8.gif
Ever since RAGING JUSTICE launched back in May, we’ve received a wealth of feedback from both old school arcade gamers and newcomers alike about everything you love and want to love about the game.

We’ve had all sorts of constructive criticism that has been passed on to the developers at MakinGames, and together we’ve worked tirelessly to bring you a wealth of improvements that we really think you’ll get a kick out of!

As of today, we’re pleased to confirm that Steam players can now take to the mean streets of RAGING JUSTICE as Rick, Nikki and Ashley in full three player co-op mode! You can even use a combination of controllers and keyboard to play as you wish!

As well as the new three player mode, we’ve also added an easier difficulty level, the ability for multiple players to play as the same character and various other improvements in response to your feedback. See below for the full list of changes…

•	3 player local co-op in all modes.
•	Difficulty adjustments to boss fights
•	Added 'colour mask' to the player-characters to allow people to play as the same character.
•	Added a new ‘Casual’ difficulty mode. Casual mode is the same difficulty as Wimp but with unlimited credits. No achievements can be unlocked on this difficulty.
•	Added ability to remap controllers.
•	Players no longer drop weapons when hit.
•	Added new cheat to the cheat menu – Unbreakable Weapons.
•	Added ability to dash with weapons.
•	Added ability to change screen resolutions
•	Minor bug fixes and improvements.

These changes are just the beginning too! While you read this, MakinGames is already busy working on Update 3, with even more new features and adjustments that we’re certain you’ll enjoy. In the meantime, we’d love to hear what you think of today’s update. So please let us know here on Steam, on Facebook or Twitter so we can keep making RAGING JUSTICE the best beat-em-up it can be.

Oh and, one more thing… If you’re looking for a friend to join you in the new three player mode then now is the time to tell them about RAGING JUSTICE as the Steam version is 40% off until August 17th!

notes.title: UPDATE 1: Stun Meter & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hi all! You may have noticed a small update to RAGING JUSTICE today. This update is intended for both PC and Mac players and includes a handful of fixes to problems highlighted by the community.

As always, if you have any feedback for RAGING JUSTICE, please make sure to let us know in the discussion forums.

IMPROVEMENTS IN PATCH 1:

•	Added Stun Power bars under enemy health bars, so you can better judge the level of stun on each enemy.
•	Fixed a bug whereby it was possible to end a stage before posting to the leaderboard.
•	Made some improvements to the analogue dead zones when using DualShock 4 controllers.
•	Small change localisation corrections.
•	Finally, you may noticed that the old Team17 logo at the start of the game has been updated to our shiny brand new version!

notes.title: New character and release date!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32005976/8d0b23cc83f013508b37e864b3cde860fcc9ccbf.gif
Hi everyone!

Today we’re very excited to reveal a third playable character for RAGING JUSTICE; Ashley King! A street-smart kid used to fending for themself, Ashley’s guaranteed to deliver a backpack full of whoop-ass should you decide to serve some justice with their help!
NAME: Ashley King
HEIGHT: 5’5”
AGE: 15
INFO: Ash’s inner-city upbringing was blighted by the fear of gang violence. Fast and lethal, Ash learned to fight on the streets, using movies as inspiration for an arsenal of lethal moves including a signature Crane Kick finisher.
Check out the brand new trailer below to see some of their kick-ass moves in action, and let us know what you think. Also, with three characters now available, which one are you picking first? 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3_1mFwMCZnc
More than just revealing the third playable character, we’re happy to confirm that RAGING JUSTICE will be coming to a Steam account near you on 8th May 2018 (alongside PS4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch)!

Will you be serving some raging justice on day one? Be sure to follow and Wishlist the game on Steam to ensure you don’t miss a beat, and that you’re ready to take to the streets in just over a month. If you’d like additional glimpses into the game alongside some inspirational Quotes of Rage between now and launch, be sure to follow RAGING JUSTICE on Twitter or Facebook as well, and join the conversation over on the community hub, or our Discord server.

notes.title: New weapons trailer and release window!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32005976/d1cdac073d79760c9127210f4f85b12713bf7e0f.png

Every great beat-em-up needs a healthy selection of weapons to pick up from the floor and smash into your foes, and RAGING JUSTICE is no exception. Rick and Nikki have their work cut out for them trying to tackle this horrible lot so we’re pleased to say they have a number of ways to deliver hard hitting justice!

These aren’t the weapons you’d normally see the police using, but then these aren’t just your ordinary police officers!Check out the new trailer to see what’s in store!

https://youtu.be/bqlq24q17mk

We have loads more to reveal about RAGING JUSTICE as we approach the Q2 2018 release date! To stay updated, make sure you’re following one of the below…

RAGING JUSTICE on Facebook
RAGING JUSTICE on Twitter
Team17 on Discord
Team17 on YouTube

RAGING JUSTICE is coming to Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, Q2 2018!

PC players, make sure to follow and add to your wishlist to stay informed!
